question: List the bowlers (including their ID, first name, and last name), match number, game number, handicap score, tournament date, and location for only those bowlers who have won games with a handicap score of 190 or less at all three venues: Thunderbird Lanes, Totem Lanes, and Bolero Lanes. Only include the specific game records where they won with a handicap score of 190 or less at these three locations.
sql:
-- Final result: bowlers who won with handicap <= 190 at all three venues
-- Return only the specific game records where they won with handicap <= 190 at those locations
WITH qualifying AS (
    SELECT bs.BowlerID
    FROM Bowler_Scores bs
    JOIN Tourney_Matches tm ON bs.MatchID = tm.MatchID
    JOIN Tournaments t ON tm.TourneyID = t.TourneyID
    WHERE t.TourneyLocation IN ('Thunderbird Lanes', 'Totem Lanes', 'Bolero Lanes')
      AND bs.WonGame = 1
      AND bs.HandiCapScore <= 190
    GROUP BY bs.BowlerID
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.TourneyLocation) = 3
)
SELECT b.BowlerID, 
       b.BowlerFirstName, 
       b.BowlerLastName, 
       bs.MatchID, 
       bs.GameNumber, 
       bs.HandiCapScore, 
       t.TourneyDate, 
       t.TourneyLocation
FROM Bowler_Scores bs
JOIN Tourney_Matches tm ON bs.MatchID = tm.MatchID
JOIN Tournaments t ON tm.TourneyID = t.TourneyID
JOIN Bowlers b ON bs.BowlerID = b.BowlerID
JOIN qualifying q ON bs.BowlerID = q.BowlerID
WHERE t.TourneyLocation IN ('Thunderbird Lanes', 'Totem Lanes', 'Bolero Lanes')
  AND bs.WonGame = 1
  AND bs.HandiCapScore <= 190
ORDER BY b.BowlerID, t.TourneyDate, bs.MatchID, bs.GameNumber

How this database is organised (written by an LLM from the tables' notes and keys):
BowlingLeague tracks active events in Bowler_Scores, Match_Games, and Tourney_Matches. Bowler_Scores records individual scores, linking to Match_Games via MatchID and GameNumber, and to Bowlers via BowlerID. Match_Games identifies winning teams. Tourney_Matches connects tournaments to matches, linking to Tournaments via TourneyID and to Teams via OddLaneTeamID and EvenLaneTeamID. Bowlers and Teams are descriptive lookup tables. Bowlers links to Teams via TeamID. Teams links to Bowlers via CaptainID. WAZips provides city-state data for Bowler addresses. Archive tables (Bowler_Scores_Archive, Match_Games_Archive, Tournaments_Archive, Tourney_Matches_Archive) are currently empty placeholders. sqlite_sequence is an internal system table for auto-increment tracking.
